caption: A bonfire on a beach burns high, and sparks and embers rise into the dark sky and wink out.

sa.check: A bonfire burns on a beach.
Sparks and embers rise from the fire.
The sparks go dark high above the fire.
The flames lean with the breeze.

pc.expect: The sparks rise with the hot air above the flames, drift and go dark, and the flames point upward from the wood.
pc.fail: The sparks fall to the sand and lie there glowing; or sink below the fire; or the flames point downward into the sand; or the sparks travel downward into the ground.

pc.expect: Each spark fades in flight and none accumulate, and the fire's wood keeps its number.
pc.fail: Sparks persist as fixed bright dots in the sky; or a glowing pile builds on the sand; or sparks appear in the sky far from the fire with none rising there; or a log vanishes at a stroke.

pc.expect: Each spark only fades as it rises and the fire's wood only chars.
pc.fail: A spark brightens again after fading; or a charred log turns back to pale unburnt wood; or the sparks stream out and then stream back into the fire; or the ash gathers back into whole logs.

pc.expect: The flames lean the same way as the smoke and anything loose in the scene.
pc.fail: The flames lean against the way the smoke streams; or the flames stand straight while the smoke is flattened; or the flames lean while the smoke rises straight and nothing else moves.

pc.expect: The fire's logs keep their shapes as they char and the beach stays sand.
pc.fail: A log turns into another object; or the logs merge into one smooth mass; or the sand opens up under the fire; or the flames pass through a log and out below it.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The sand, the sea behind and the surroundings stay the same.
pc.fail: The sand changes colour; or the sea's edge jumps to a new place; or the background changes between frames.
